svg.text: GREEN pages — initial isolation and protective-action distances

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Used when the yellow or blue entry is highlighted and the material is highlighted in the green table (often toxic inhalation hazards). Wind and spill size matter.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Get the ID number (from the shipping paper or the orange ID panel) or the proper shipping name.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Use YELLOW pages for the ID number, or BLUE pages for the name, and read the orange guide number.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Turn to that ORANGE guide for hazards and immediate actions. If the entry is highlighted, also use the GREEN table.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Shipping papers and placards must match. Wrong ID/name on the paper means the wrong ERG guide. (DL 650 p. 9-19.)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: PHMSA Emergency Response Guidebook (official current ERG) and DL 650 (REV 12/2019) p. 9-19. Not official ERG artwork. https://www.phmsa.dot.gov/training/hazmat/erg/emergency-response-guidebook-erg
